info.name: JSONPlaceholder API Tests
info.description: Comprehensive API test suite for JSONPlaceholder REST API with 30+ test cases covering Posts, Users, Comments, Albums, and Photos resources

item.name: Smoke Tests
item.description: Quick tests to verify basic API functionality

item.name: GET All Posts
item.description: API-B-001: Verify API is responding and returns posts
item.tests: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("Response is array", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); }); pm.test("Response has posts", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.length).to.be.at.least(1); }); pm.test("Each post has required fields", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); data.forEach(function(post) { pm.expect(post).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(post).to.have.property('userId'); pm.expect(post).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(post).to.have.property('body'); }); });

item.name: GET Single Post
item.description: API-B-003: Verify single post retrieval
item.tests: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("Response is object", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('object'); }); pm.test("Post has all required fields", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('userId'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('body'); }); pm.test("Post ID matches", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.id).to.equal(1); });

item.name: GET All Users
item.description: API-U-001: Verify users endpoint
item.tests: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("Response is array", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); }); pm.test("Response has users", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.length).to.be.at.least(1); });

item.name: Posts

item.name: GET All Posts - Full Validation
item.description: API-B-001 & API-B-002: Complete validation of GET /posts
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-001: Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("API-B-002: Response is array", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); }); pm.test("API-B-002: Has exactly 100 posts", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.lengthOf(100); }); pm.test("API-B-002: Each post has correct structure", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); data.forEach(function(post) { pm.expect(post.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(post.userId).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(post.title).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(post.body).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: GET Single Post - Full Validation
item.description: API-B-003 & API-B-004: Complete validation of GET /posts/:id
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-003: Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("API-B-004: Response has correct structure", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.id).to.be.a('number').and.to.equal(1); pm.expect(data.userId).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.title).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.body).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: GET Posts by User ID
item.description: API-B-006: Verify filtering by userId parameter
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-006: Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("API-B-006: All posts belong to user 1", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); data.forEach(function(post) { pm.expect(post.userId).to.equal(1); }); }); pm.test("API-B-006: Response is array", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: GET Posts with Multiple Query Params
item.description: API-B-007: Verify multiple query parameters
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-007: Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("API-B-007: Response has at most 5 items", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.length).to.be.at.most(5); }); pm.test("API-B-007: All posts belong to user 1", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); data.forEach(function(post) { pm.expect(post.userId).to.equal(1); }); });

item.name: POST Create Valid Post
item.description: API-B-008 & API-B-009: Create new post with valid data
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-008: Status code is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); }); pm.test("API-B-009: Response contains ID", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(data.id).to.be.a('number'); }); pm.test("API-B-009: Response contains title", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.title).to.equal('Test Post'); }); pm.test("API-B-009: Store created post ID", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdPostId', data.id); });

item.name: PUT Update Post
item.description: API-B-013 & API-B-014: Update existing post
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-013: Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("API-B-014: Response contains updated data", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.title).to.equal('Updated Title'); pm.expect(data.body).to.equal('Updated body'); pm.expect(data.id).to.equal(1); });

item.name: PATCH Partial Update
item.description: API-B-016: Partial update of post
item.tests: pm.test("API-B-016: Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test("API-B-016: Title is updated", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.title).to.equal('Partially Updated Title'); }); pm.test("API-B-016: Other fields preserved", function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('body'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('userId'); });
